{{Quote|What should I think about now? I &ndash; I don't know what to do with my head. I don't know what to do with my hands&hellip;|A slave, under the effects of SLV-16|audio=SlaveCaptain-SLV16-TOR.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''SLV-16 serum''' was a potent psychoactive medication developed by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Intelligence]] arm of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It sapped the willpower of most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], leaving an individual obedient and helpless for one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] before its effects wore off. [[Color/Legends|Blue]] in coloration, one such serum was given to the future [[Cipher Nine]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] by [[Imperial High Command (Sith Empire)|Imperial Command]] for use on a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] leader on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
